description: This file contains custom Keras layer classes used in object detection models, including layers for generating anchors, upsampling tensors, applying regression to bounding boxes, and clipping boxes within image boundaries.

classes.name: Anchors
classes.description: A Keras layer for generating anchor boxes for object detection, based on input feature map shape, with configurable sizes, ratios, and scales.

classes.name: UpsampleLike
classes.description: A Keras layer for upsampling a tensor to match the shape of another tensor, used in feature pyramid networks.

classes.name: RegressBoxes
classes.description: A Keras layer that applies regression deltas to anchor boxes to produce refined bounding box predictions.

classes.name: ClipBoxes
classes.description: A Keras layer that clips bounding box coordinates to stay within image boundaries.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Defines the forward pass for each custom layer, performing operations like generating anchors, resizing tensors, applying regression, or clipping boxes.

methods.name: compute_output_shape
methods.description: Calculates the output shape of the layer based on input shape, considering image data format and tensor dimensions.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the layer for serialization, including parameters like size, stride, ratios, and scales.
